verified_sources.source: Technical guidance for GML files / INSPIRE
facts: INSPIRE data is supplied in GML
HMLR polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid
British National Grid CRS is EPSG:27700
HMLR warns projection conversion can introduce positional error
HMLR warns BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15m
QGIS can reproject GML into other CRS
format conversion and CRS conversion are separate operations
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent
each INSPIRE polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title
dataset is split by local authority
boundary-crossing polygons can appear in more than one local-authority file
files are refreshed on the first Sunday each month

promotion_rule: Parcel binding must retain original BNG geometry or use a controlled high-accuracy transformation; uncontrolled web-map reprojection cannot promote a measurement.
